reuse.why: Passes the flag into the existing shared getMonthWideCategories used by all six month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth via its eligible-id set.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one SQL fragment inside getMonthWideCategories; each action only forwards its flag, sharing one MonthWideArgs type.

placement.why: The change lives in the shared selection function in budget/actions.ts beside the template and #fixed rules.

scope.why: Flag plumbing, the selection change, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: One definition with an explicit parameter for the hidden variation and a consistent argument type across all actions.
